expectations.evidence: grep 'standards/openspec' over response.md returns exactly 3 hits, none of which recommends it as this proposal's landing spot: line 36 is an explicitly labelled counterexample — "最容易误落的候选是把它写进共享子模块：" then `standards/openspec/changes/sort-tasks-by-due-date/proposal.md   ← 错`; line 41 cites the prohibition — 「项目变更放本项目 `openspec/changes/`，不放 `standards/openspec/changes/`」; line 112 references `standards/openspec/templates/proposal-minimal.md` (a template, not a changes/ landing path). Line 47 mentions "落 standards 仓自己的 `openspec/changes/`" only for changes whose OBJECT is the methodology itself (改十步循环 / 改模板 / 改 conventions), and immediately contrasts it: "按截止日期排序的对象是 todo-web 的任务列表功能，属于项目自身 ⇒ 落 todo-web 的 `openspec/`。"

expectations.text: 对 (2) 给出的理由点到「standards 是共享子模块 / 项目自己的变更归项目自己」这层语义 (Aria 不可协商规则 #5), 而不是只给路径不解释
expectations.evidence: response.md §2 gives four ranked reasons that reach exactly that semantics. 【1】 line 41: "**Aria 不可协商规则 #5 直接禁止**：「项目变更放本项目 `openspec/changes/`，不放 `standards/openspec/changes/`」". 【2】 line 43: "**所有权判据**：`standards/` 是从 aria-standards 引入的**共享子模块**，是所有采用 Aria 方法论的项目共读的规范 SOT。把 todo-web 的一个产品功能写进去，这份变更会对**所有采用方可见且无人拥有**". 【3】 adds the mechanical consequence (submodule update --remote 冲掉 / 污染共享 repo). 【4】 states the ownership boundary criterion "这个变更的**对象**是谁".

suggestions.reason: No assertion covers a discriminating Level 2 behavior that this run did get right: Level 2 must produce proposal.md ONLY, with no tasks.md. The response states it twice (§0 A.1.4 "Level 2 只产 `proposal.md`，**不生成 tasks.md**" and §1 "同目录下不建 `tasks.md`"). An arm that emitted a tasks.md alongside — the classic Level 2/3 confusion — would still pass all four current assertions.

suggestions.assertion: 全文任何位置都没有把 `standards/openspec/changes/` 当作本次 proposal 的落点推荐 (作为反例点名说明「不该写那里」不算违反)
suggestions.reason: The counterexample carve-out is judgment-dependent, so two graders can split on a hedged answer (e.g. "也可以放 standards/openspec/changes/，看团队约定"). Consider tightening to a mechanical criterion: every occurrence of `standards/openspec/changes/` must be adjacent to an explicit negative marker (错 / 不放 / 禁止 / ← wrong), otherwise fail.

suggestions.assertion: 给出的落点路径是项目自己仓内的 `openspec/changes/<feature>/proposal.md` (feature 名可自拟), 且**不是** `standards/openspec/changes/...`
suggestions.reason: As literally worded, a bare `openspec/changes/x/proposal.md` with no anchor would pass, leaving ambiguous whether it means the todo-web root or the standards submodule's internal openspec/. This run removed the ambiguity on its own (line 25 "相对 **todo-web 仓库根**"); an assertion requiring that the path be explicitly anchored to the consuming project's repo root would make the check discriminating rather than dependent on the executor volunteering it.

eval_feedback.overall: All four assertions are cleanly satisfied with literal evidence; the set is well-targeted on Rule #5 and the Linked Issue sentinel, but leaves the Level 2 no-tasks.md outcome unchecked and relies on grader judgment for the counterexample carve-out.
